Empirical concurrency study

Measured, not vibes:
concurrent primitives under one harness.

Every implementation in this repository — hand-rolled broadcasters, caster-likes, scatter dispatchers, gather barriers, async payload lanes and bounded fan-in lane mergers — exercised by the same batteries, the same timers, the same GC settings, and the same pass/fail gates. The sections below unpack throughput, latency, allocation, scalability, stall resilience, churn, withdrawal compensation and payload integrity.

Pathology Lab

A consumer stops reading. What happens?

Three lanes: publisher, two healthy subscribers, one permanently stalled subscriber that never calls Receive. Watch both traces side by side — or open any pair from the grid. Blocked publishers are parked, never killed; the harness unwinds them with watchdogs and GC.

vs

Retained bytes after the storm (stalled consumer, post-GC)

Publishers that keep running past a stalled lane either drop, coalesce, or buffer. Retained = heap growth attributable to the stalled lane after forcing a GC.

Correctness signals

Zero tolerance, measured explicitly

Three independent gates: multi-word payload integrity (seqlock torn-read probe), rendezvous withdrawal compensation (did Add(-1) unstick a parked Send?), exactly-once scatter accounting, plus the harness verifier.

Methodology & schema

How to read every number here

The harness lives in measure_*_test.go; results are line-delimited JSON written incrementally, one record per measurement, then verified by bigbuff-measure verify before this page was rendered.

Design principles
  • Single harness, all implementations. Every battery constructs the implementation through its registry factory, warms it, measures under identical GC (GOGC=off for alloc batteries) and scheduling conditions, and reports distributional stats — never a bare mean.
  • Deterministic scheduling pressure. Churn and contention batteries use exact iteration counts, channels and WaitGroups; timeouts are deadlock guards, never readiness probes. No sleeps anywhere.
  • Pathology probes are honest. A publisher parked by construction is an expected outcome, recorded as publisher_blocked; recover converts panics to publisher_panicked. Blocking cleanup (Unsubscribe/Close) is skipped or watchdog-bounded after a blocked probe — the harness would otherwise deadlock the runtime. This asymmetry is deliberate and documented.
  • Passability. go test stays green: measure subcommands run under go test -run=NONE -args bigbuff-measure …; batteries assert only what their design can guarantee and record the rest. Verification enforces that every registered implementation was measured or explicitly skipped with a reason.
Batteries & metrics
Record schema (JSONL v1)

One record per line. type is one of meta, metric, trace, skipped, summary, registry.

metricrecord kind; dims carry the sweep dimension (subs / receivers / senders)
mean / stddev / cvdistributional summaries over reps repetitions of ops operations each
p50 / p90 / p99 / maxreservoir-sampled latencies (ADR-004 HDR-ish reservoir, per-run)
ci95_low / ci95_highWelch-adjusted 95% half-width on the per-op mean (t-distribution, df = n−1)
approx_retained_bytespost-GC heap growth attributable to a permanently stalled subscriber
exactly_once_violationsscatter items neither delivered exactly once nor counted as evicted, summed over all receivers incl. warmup; non-zero fails the integrity gate
evicted / delivered_fractionscatter items a bounded queue evicted by contract, and the fraction of sent items delivered; dispatch_ns_op is per delivered item
torn_reads / checkedpayload lanes caught serving mismatched [4]uint64 halves vs loads checked
withdrawal_compensation_successfraction of rounds where Add(-1) unstuck a Send parked on a never-receiving intent
exposure_limitedtrue when the implementation is excluded from batteries it would fail by construction (policy: limit exposure, never mis-measure)
expected_good_fit / scenariosattachment registry: the scenarios this implementation was designed for
Adoptability score

Percentile rank within family, weighted: throughput .28 · stall resilience .20 · scaling .16 · latency .14 · allocations .14 · churn .08. Stall resilience uses log₁₀(completed ops) vs family peers. Any torn read or exactly-once scatter violation caps the score at 50 and marks the implementation “Do not adopt”. A 100 means “best in class on measured axes”, not “use everywhere” — read the radar, not just the number.

Threats to validity
  • Shared-hardware noise (this run: GOMAXPROCS=2 Xeon @ 2.60GHz). Use quick for regression gates, standard/full for decisions; compare ratios, not absolutes.
  • The stalled-consumer battery is a bound, not a leak: publishers parked mid-probe by construction are excluded from cleanup; retention is post-GC heap attribution, approximate by nature.
  • Trace events truncate at the configured event budget; outcomes and ops counters are still exact.
  • Torn-read coverage depends on delivery counts; implementations with zero deliveries under the probe report insufficient-data, never a fabricated zero.
  • Registry attachments are authored judgments (expected good/bad fit); they are metadata for interpretation, not measurements.
